question: Why do many patients hold back from talking to nurses about sexual health problems?
explanation: It is completely normal for people to feel shy or worried about judgment when discussing intimate health. Creating a safe, open space as a nurse helps patients feel comfortable opening up! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h1)

question: Why is asking about sexual health an important part of routine nursing care?

options.A: It eliminates the need for any laboratory testing
options.B: It ensures compliance with hospital billing policies
options.C: It validates sexual health as a vital component of holistic well-being
options.D: It shortens the overall length of the hospital stay

explanation: Nursing is about caring for the whole person body and mind. Addressing intimate health ensures we look at quality of life, not just curing an illness. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h1)

question: What does a 'secondary' sexual dysfunction mean for a patient?

options.A: It only affects secondary sex characteristics
options.B: It occurs only during physical exercise
options.C: It is caused strictly by prescription eye drops
options.D: It developed after a period of normal sexual function

explanation: Think of secondary as coming 'after'. A secondary dysfunction means the patient used to have normal, trouble-free function before the issue started. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h2)

question: A patient notices he cannot get an erection anymore shortly after starting a new blood pressure drug. How would you classify this?
explanation: Spot on! Because his sexual function was fine before starting the medication, this is classified as a secondary issue tied to the new drug. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h2)

question: Which group of medications is well-known for causing sexual side effects like low libido or delayed orgasm?
explanation: SSRIs are common antidepressants that unfortunately often interfere with sexual desire and climax. Always keep an eye out for this when counseling patients! [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h3)

question: Why is it important to check both physical health and mental status when assessing sexual problems?

options.A: Physical illnesses and emotional stress frequently interact to impair sexual function
options.B: Physical causes are always temporary while psychological ones are permanent
options.C: Medical insurance will not pay for treatment without both evaluations
options.D: Psychological causes can never be treated with medication

explanation: The body and mind work as a team. Good sexual health needs healthy blood vessels, steady hormones, and peace of mind all working together. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h3)

question: What is the main goal of 'sensate focus' exercises in sex therapy?

options.A: To replace all forms of verbal communication between partners
options.B: To test the physical endurance of the cardiovascular system
options.C: To eliminate performance anxiety by removing the pressure of intercourse
options.D: To increase muscular strength in the lower pelvic floor

explanation: Sensate focus helps couples slow down and reconnect through gentle touch, taking away the stressful expectation of sexual performance. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h4)

question: Why is couples counseling often recommended when treating sexual dysfunction?

options.A: Because sexual problems usually impact both partners in the relationship
options.B: To legally bind partners to follow the treatment plan
options.C: Because individual therapy is strictly illegal for sexual issues
options.D: To prove which partner is at fault for the problem

explanation: Intimacy is shared between two people. Involving both partners encourages teamwork and open communication, which speeds up healing. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h4)

question: What dangerous drug interaction must you warn patients about when taking ED meds like sildenafil (Viagra)?

options.A: Taking them with dairy products causes permanent blindness
options.B: Combining them with organic nitrates causes severe hypotension
options.C: Swallowing them with fruit juice stops their absorption entirely
options.D: Mixing them with aspirin causes sudden kidney failure

explanation: This is a classic clinical pearl! Both nitrates (for heart pain) and PDE5 inhibitors drop blood pressure. Taking them together can cause a life-threatening crash. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h5)

question: Why do drugs like sildenafil fail to work if the patient lacks sexual stimulation?

options.A: They are digested too quickly by stomach acid without excitement
options.B: They require the physical presence of a medical doctor to activate
options.C: They only enhance the natural signaling pathway triggered by arousal
options.D: They act purely as sedatives for the nervous system

explanation: Pau-cle! These medications don't cause automatic arousal on their own; they simply boost the body's natural blood flow response when stimulation is already there. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h5)

question: Which lifestyle habit directly damages blood vessels and is a major cause of sexual dysfunction?
explanation: Smoking harms blood vessel walls and reduces blood flow all over the body, which heavily impacts sexual function. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h6)

question: A patient asks if changing their diet and exercising can help with mild erectile dysfunction. What is the best response?

options.A: Once sexual dysfunction starts, lifestyle changes can never reverse it
options.B: Diet and exercise only affect heart disease and have no link to sexual function
options.C: You should stop exercising immediately to preserve your energy
options.D: Lifestyle changes improve blood circulation and can significantly benefit sexual health

explanation: Absolutely! What is good for the heart is good for sexual health. Better circulation means better physical function overall. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h6)

question: Which professional has special training to help couples work through emotional and intimacy problems?
explanation: Sex therapists have specialized training to guide couples through psychological and emotional intimacy bumps on the road. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h7)

question: What is a key role for the nurse when caring for a patient dealing with sexual dysfunction?

options.A: Coordinating referrals and ensuring the patient transitions smoothly between specialists
options.B: Deciding which prescription drugs the pharmacy will stock
options.C: Diagnosing rare endocrine disorders without physician oversight
options.D: Performing advanced surgical procedures independently in the clinic

explanation: Nurses act as the bridge! We connect patients with the right specialists (like therapists or urologists) to make sure they get team-based, compassionate care. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T27#GNS312_U1_T27_h7)
